@inherits_common_solid_feature_tool
Feature: Extrude a profile in a part document
  The MCAD Software extrudes selected sketch profiles into solid or surface features.

  Background:
    Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace
    And the viewport pointer is idle

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-01 Empty part entry requests a sketch plane
    Given a new Standard (mm) part with no sketch
    When Extrude is clicked and a displayed origin plane is selected
    Then Sketch1 opens for profile creation

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-02 Finish profile returns to waiting extrusion
    Given a rectangle was drawn in the sketch requested by Extrude
    When Finish Sketch is clicked
    Then the Extrusion panel shows one selected profile
    And a solid preview displays Distance A of 10 mm

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-03 Select Flipped direction
    Given the rectangle extrusion preview is open at Default direction
    When Flipped is selected in Direction
    Then the preview changes its side or extent relative to Default direction

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-03a Select Symmetric direction
    Given the rectangle extrusion preview is open at Default direction
    When Symmetric is selected in Direction
    Then the preview extends on both sides of the source plane

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-03b Select Asymmetric direction
    Given the rectangle extrusion preview is open at Default direction
    When Asymmetric is selected in Direction
    Then the preview changes its side or extent relative to Default direction
    And Distance B and Taper B controls appear

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-03c Choose named directions with the dropdown selector
    Given the rectangle extrusion preview is open with icon direction controls
    When the user opens the Direction menu
    Then Selector Style offers Icons and Dropdown
    And Icons is selected
    When the user chooses Dropdown
    Then the Direction field displays Default
    When the user opens the Direction list
    Then it offers Default, Flipped, Symmetric and Asymmetric
    When the user opens the Direction menu and chooses Icons
    Then the four direction icons are visible again

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-04 Cancel preserves the source sketch
    Given the uncommitted rectangle extrusion preview
    When Cancel is clicked
    Then the shaded preview disappears and Sketch1 remains
    When the user presses E
    Then the extrusion panel reopens for the source sketch

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-05 Zero distance validation and recovery
    Given Default direction with a selected profile
    When Distance A is replaced with 0
    Then a red error indicator appears and OK is disabled
    When the value is replaced with 8
    Then the error clears and OK becomes available

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-06 Accepted creation supports Undo and Redo
    Given Distance A 8 mm and zero taper
    When OK is clicked then Undo then Redo
    Then Extrusion1 and Solid Bodies(1) return with the shaded solid
    And the subsequent Measure result lists two extrusion edges of length 8.000 mm

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-07 Edit Feature accepts positive taper
    Given the accepted untapered Extrusion1
    When Edit Feature is chosen from its browser context menu
    Then Distance A is retained as 8 mm and Taper A as zero degrees
    When Taper A is replaced with 5 and OK is clicked
    Then the edited solid visibly widens toward the far end

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-08 Taper history retains accepted value
    Given Extrusion1 has accepted positive taper of 5 degrees
    When Undo then Redo are invoked and Edit Feature is opened
    Then the widening shape returns and Taper A shows 5 degrees

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-09 Cancel reversed taper edit
    Given Edit Feature with Taper A 5 degrees
    When its sign control is clicked
    Then Taper A shows -5 degrees and the preview narrows
    When Cancel is clicked and Edit Feature is reopened
    Then the retained value is positive 5 degrees

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-10 Reference selectors require input
    Given a sketch-plane start and numeric distance
    When the From reference control is activated
    Then missing From and To references show Select Face
    And OK is disabled without a shaded solid preview
    When the reference control is restored
    Then Sketch Plane and the numeric distance preview return

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-11 Termination selection displays a To reference
    Given the numeric Distance A extrusion preview
    When the user activates the termination control
    Then a To reference selector appears
    And no reference means disabled OK

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-12 Distance tolerance dialog can be inspected and cancelled
    Given Edit Feature with Distance A 8 mm
    When Tolerance is opened from its dropdown
    Then Model Value is 8.000 mm and Type is Default
    And Precision, evaluated-size controls, Upper and Lower fields, Hole and Shaft fields are visible
    When the Type list is opened
    Then it offers Default, Basic, Symmetric, Deviation, Limits-Stacked, Limits-Linear, MAX, MIN, Limits/Fits-Stacked, Limits/Fits-Linear, Limits/Fits-Show Size Limits and Limits/Fits-Show Tolerance
    When the Type list is dismissed and Cancel is clicked
    Then the extrusion panel remains at Distance A 8 mm

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-12a Inspect the Distance A editor menu
    Given Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion
    When the user opens the Distance A editor menu
    Then it offers Measure, Select Feature Dimension, Parameters, Tolerance and List Parameters
    When the user chooses List Parameters
    Then a list of parameters available in the active part appears
    When the user dismisses the list and clicks Cancel
    Then the extrusion edit closes without changing the feature

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-12b Select Feature Dimension prompts for a feature
    Given Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion
    When the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Select Feature Dimension
    Then the status area asks the user to select a feature and then one of its dimensions
    When the user cancels the extrusion edit
    Then the accepted feature remains unchanged

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-12c Parameters opens the part parameter table
    Given Edit Feature is open for an existing extrusion
    When the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Parameters
    Then a Parameters dialog opens for the active part
    And the table includes parameter name, consumed-by, unit or type, equation, nominal value, tolerance and model value columns
    When the user clicks Done
    Then the extrusion panel remains open
    When the user clicks Cancel
    Then the accepted feature remains unchanged

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-13 Join adds a boss to one body
    Given a diameter-3 circular sketch on the top face of the existing solid
    When Extrude uses Default direction, Distance A 8 mm, zero taper and Join
    And OK is clicked
    Then a cylindrical boss and Extrusion2 are visible
    And the browser still shows Solid Bodies(1)
    When Undo is invoked
    Then Sketch2 returns and the boss disappears

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-14 New Solid creates a named second body
    Given the restored circular Sketch2 and existing Solid1
    When Extrude uses New Solid with Distance A 8 mm and zero taper
    And Body Name is replaced with b and OK is clicked
    Then the browser shows Solid Bodies(2)
    And expanding it shows Solid1 and b

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-15 Cut selects inward direction and supports history
    Given the diameter-3 circle on the base top face
    When Extrude opens in Default direction and Cut is selected
    Then Direction changes to Flipped and the preview shows an opening
    When OK is clicked with Distance A 8 mm and zero taper
    Then Extrusion2 and the opening are retained in one solid body
    When Undo then Redo are invoked
    Then the opening disappears then returns

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-16 Intersect retains the circular common region
    Given the base and restored circular Sketch2
    When Intersect is selected in Extrude
    Then Direction changes to Flipped and a cylindrical region is previewed
    When OK is clicked with Distance A 8 mm and zero taper
    Then the cylinder replaces the visible rectangular base result
    And the browser retains one solid body
    When Undo then Redo are invoked
    Then the base returns then the cylinder returns

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-17 Measure identifies intersection diameter
    Given the accepted Intersect result after Redo
    When its top face and cylindrical face are selected in Measure
    Then the top face area is 7.069 square mm
    And the cylindrical face diameter is 3.000 mm and radius 1.500 mm

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-18 Auxiliary extent changes preview and accepts a cut
    Given the circular profile on the existing solid
    When the first auxiliary extent icon beside Distance A is clicked
    Then direction shows Flipped and Boolean shows Cut
    And the displayed distance is parenthesized
    When OK is clicked
    Then the opening is retained
    When Undo is invoked
    Then Sketch2 and the uncut top face return

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-19 Surface output retains separate surface entry
    Given the circular extrusion preview displaying Distance A 10 mm
    When the output-type icon is clicked
    Then input shows 1 Curve and Body Name shows Srf1
    When OK is clicked
    Then ExtrusionSrf1 and Surface Bodies(1) appear beside Solid Bodies(1)
    When Undo then Redo are invoked
    Then the surface disappears then returns

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-20 Dimension pick can change the active distance expression
    Given two disjoint closed loops and one rectangle selected for extrusion
    When the user opens the Distance A editor menu and chooses Measure
    Then the status area asks the user to select a dimension to reference the parameter
    When the circle dimension annotation is picked
    Then Distance A references d2 instead of adding another profile
    And a later pick produces invalid d2d2 and disabled OK
    When Cancel is clicked
    Then no new extrusion is accepted

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-21 Hide Presets controls preset-row visibility
    Given Extrusion with Hide Presets checked
    When Hide Presets is unchecked from the panel menu
    Then the No Preset row, plus and gear controls appear
    When the preset gear menu is inspected and dismissed
    And Hide Presets is restored
    Then the preset row disappears

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-22 Change and flip an asymmetric preview
    Given the extrusion is edited with Asymmetric direction
    And Distance A is 8 mm and Distance B is 4 mm
    When Distance B is changed to 6 mm
    Then the lower preview displays a 6 mm dimension
    When the flip control beside Distance B is clicked
    Then Distance A displays 6 mm and Distance B displays 8 mm
    And the displayed taper values exchange between A and B

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-23 Cancel a failed edit in the dependent part
    Given Extrusion1 is edited in the Part9 with downstream Fillet1 and Sketch3
    When Asymmetric is selected with distances 8 mm and 4 mm and OK is clicked
    Then the MCAD Software reports that editing the extrusion failed
    And the expanded update details list Fillet1 and Sketch3 problems
    When Cancel is clicked in the error dialog
    Then the dialog closes and the part is displayed again

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: extrusion-24 Match Shape is disabled for the captured feature
    Given Edit Feature is open for the captured solid extrusion
    Then Match Shape is visible and disabled
    When Cancel is clicked
    Then the accepted feature remains unchanged

  @needs_fixture @capture_only @capture_host_only
  Scenario: extrusion-live-01 Reopen Extrusion1 and cancel its edit
    Given the captured Part7 document contains Extrusion1 and one solid body
    When the user double-clicks Extrusion1 in the model browser
    Then the Extrusion panel restores 1 Profile from 1 Sketch Plane
    And Distance A is 20 mm and the body name is Solid1
    And Taper A is 0 degrees with Match Shape checked and disabled
    And a 20 mm viewport preview appears
    When the user cancels the edit
    Then the panel closes and the committed solid remains unchanged
